Independent immutable P-256 signing key; ES256 compact JWS verified with JOSE against the enrolled public key
Exact raw body, method, URL including query, idempotency key, identity, tenant, session, source session, device and key fingerprint binding
Server-issued, single-use nonces with stored expiry and atomic per-session pending budget
Bound active device and current-generation grant pinned in every protected data transaction
Narrow pending-device bootstrap exceptions without automatic roles or grants
Exact-device revocation marks bound sessions revoked in the same tenant transaction
Immutable GestionChurch source-session association and current-source comparison
Bounded expired-nonce housekeeping without runtime DELETE or EXECUTE privileges
